name: Orhan Dlamini-Kurikka
location: The Core, near State and Monroe

physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with olive undertones, reflecting mixed heritage
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but well-maintained; fine lines around the eyes and mouth from forty-two years of reading rooms and situations; strong jawline; kept clean-shaven except for a thin line of stubble by evening
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running 2cm along the left cheekbone, old enough to blend with natural skin creases

physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Orhan keeps his chrome invisible—subcutaneous neural overlay for augmented reality feeds, internal comms, encrypted data access. A stranger would notice nothing.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled. Stands with weight balanced, never sprawling. Moves through space with deliberate intent, each gesture minimal but communicative. Listens more than talks; eyes track everything. Hands rest in lap or pockets—never exposed
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 corporate casual that reads as understated wealth. Charcoal wool slacks, dark fitted turtlenecks or simple dress shirts in black or gray, a worn but expensive leather jacket (Suomi make, pre-2200s). No logos, no flash. A simple stainless steel watch, nothing smart. The overall effect: someone you'd trust with your life, or your secrets
